overview_description.description: CoinMENA is a Sharia-compliant crypto-assets trading platform where users can buy, sell, store, and receive digital assets safely and securely. Individuals and institutions looking to buy and sell large quantities of digital assets can benefit from CoinMENA's more private and personalized service. CoinMENA aims to be the region's easiest and most trusted digital asset exchange platform by offering competitive fees, high liquidity, and an educational approach.
